record.body:
## Evidence

Pre-fix unit/pilot: waiting title cells included `waits on a, b` (and long dep lists). `title_cell` built `note = f"  waits on {', '.join(sorted(task.waits_on))}"` and appended it without clipping. After removing the note, focused slice passed (7 tests).

## Consequence

Row wrap and vertical stretch came from the unclipped waits-on suffix in the task column, not from status or model `waits_on` computation.

## Follow-up

none — fix landed in the worktree; blockers remain via task detail Depends on.
